bill.name: Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act)
bill.label: H.R. 3633, 119th Congress
bill.what: Splits crypto oversight between the CFTC (digital commodities, spot markets) and the SEC (investment contracts), sets a path for tokens to count as decentralized, and registers exchanges, brokers and dealers.

status_note: Stalled in the Senate after a failed cloture vote on 2026-09-15 (49-50, 60 needed). A motion to reconsider keeps a later vote possible; the lame-duck session after the 2026-11-03 midterms is the last window for this Congress.

milestones.event: Introduced in the House by Financial Services Chair French Hill
Received in the Senate, referred to the Banking Committee
Senate Banking advanced an amended version, 15-9
Reported to the full Senate and placed on the calendar
Merged Senate draft released, adding ethics language
Senate cloture on the motion to proceed failed, 49-50; Tillis entered a motion to reconsider
